title: Bypass the frontend's tactic preamble in both proof exporters
summary: Both proof exporters now send the assertions straight to a proof core, skipping Z3's tactic preamble that invented fresh symbols, so single-occurrence QF_UFLRA inputs, Bool-only predicates, and arithmetic inputs with if-then-else terms certify in Lean through both cores. The reconstructor also groups if-then-else terms up to the rewriter's normal form.
